basic_details.job_title: IIT Hyderabad Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Two Junior Research Fellow (JRF) positions are open in the research group of Dr. Shourya Dutta Gupta, Materials Science and Metallurgical Engineering (MSME), Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad, with ICMR as the sponsoring agency. The position runs for 12 months (can be extended based on performance) with a fellowship of 37,000 + HRA (as per applicable norms). Candidates with a first-class M.E./M.Tech., or M.Sc. or B.E./B.Tech. with first class and a valid GATE score, among other routes, can apply through the Google Form on or before 5 PM on 10 November 2026.

important_dates.interview_date: To be informed by email to shortlisted candidates

content_sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad JRF at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: 12 months (can be extended based on performance)
Research group of Dr. Shourya Dutta Gupta, MSME, IIT Hyderabad, Kandi, Sangareddy, Telangana

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists four alternative routes for the essential qualification. A candidate needs to meet any one of them: Candidates with Master's (M.E./M.Tech. (or equivalent)) with first class, OR M.Sc. or equivalent in any science discipline with first class and a valid GATE score (or qualified one of the national exams: INSPIRE, Joint CSIR-UGC NET with JRF, DBT JRF), OR B.Tech. students from CFIs with a CGPA of 8.0 or more are eligible to apply (no GATE required), OR B.E./B.Tech. or equivalent in any discipline with first class and a valid GATE score. Candidates with one or more of the following skills are encouraged to apply: Optical sensor (or biosensor) development Nanoparticle synthesis (or nanofabrication) and characterization Spectroscopy and imaging of biosensors Development of imaging/spectroscopic setups/platforms using Arduino/ESP32 (or any others) Familiarity with coding in python/MATLAB (or any other language), especially for GUI development The age limit is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility wording before applying.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is 37,000 plus HRA, with the HRA paid as per applicable norms. The JRF tenure is 12 months and can be extended based on performance. The selected candidate will be encouraged to register for the PhD program at IIT Hyderabad as per the institute's norms.

content_sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad JRF Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate would be involved in: Development of biosensors for eye disease diagnostics (and work closely with clinicians at LVPEI, Hyderabad). Development of imaging and spectroscopic platforms for sensors. Development of software platforms for system control, data acquisition, and visualization. Preparation of technical reports, publications, and patents arising from the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Hyderabad JRF
content_sections.text: Interested candidates should apply by filling out the Google Form ( https://forms.gle/UT5wXk3Ygckp7Skx6 ) on or before 5 PM on 10 November 2026. As of 2 November 2026, the application window is open. The notice does not list any documents to attach. For additional information, candidates can contact Dr. Shourya Dutta Gupta at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their academic record/achievements. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed by e-mail and called for an interview with the selection committee. The interview date will be sent to shortlisted candidates by email, and the interview will be held in online mode. Meeting the minimum criteria does not guarantee a call for an interview. The selection committee's decision would be final.

faq.question: Q1. How many JRF vacancies are there in IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice announces Two (02) Junior Research Fellow positions in the research group of Dr. Shourya Dutta Gupta, MSME, IIT Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Hyderabad JRF posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted through the Google Form on or before 5 PM on 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the IIT Hyderabad JRF?
faq.answer: Candidates need one of the following: M.E./M.Tech. (or equivalent) with first class; M.Sc. in any science discipline with first class and a valid GATE score (or INSPIRE, Joint CSIR-UGC NET with JRF or DBT JRF); a B.Tech. from CFIs with a CGPA of 8.0 or more; or B.E./B.Tech. with first class and a valid GATE score.

faq.question: Q4. Can B.Tech. candidates apply without a GATE score?
faq.answer: Yes, B.Tech. students from CFIs with a CGPA of 8.0 or more can apply without GATE. Other B.E./B.Tech. candidates need first class and a valid GATE score.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship for the IIT Hyderabad JRF?
faq.answer: The fellowship is 37,000 + HRA (as per applicable norms).

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes, HRA is paid in addition to the 37,000 fellowship, as per applicable norms.

faq.question: Q7. How to apply for the IIT Hyderabad JRF?
faq.answer: Candidates apply by filling out the Google Form (https://forms.gle/UT5wXk3Ygckp7Skx6) on or before 5 PM on 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the IIT Hyderabad JRF?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on their academic record/achievements, and shortlisted candidates are called by e-mail for an online interview with the selection committee.

faq.question: Q9. Is the IIT Hyderabad JRF a permanent position?
faq.answer: No, the JRF tenure is 12 months and can be extended based on performance. The project is sponsored by ICMR.

faq.question: Q10. Can the JRF register for a PhD at IIT Hyderabad?
faq.answer: Yes, the selected candidate will be encouraged to register for the PhD program at IIT Hyderabad as per the institute's norms.
